scripts.demo:game: bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && bun run demo:game:dev
scripts.demo:game:build: bun run generate:check && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && bun examples/cordon-off/build.ts
scripts.demo:quorum: bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && bun run demo:quorum:dev
scripts.demo:quorum:build: bun run generate:check && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && bun examples/quorum/build.ts
scripts.demo:verso: bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && bun run demo:verso:dev
scripts.demo:verso:build: bun run generate:check && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && bun examples/verso/build.ts
scripts.test:quorum: bun run generate:check && bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && bun test examples/quorum && bun examples/quorum/smoke.ts
scripts.test:verso: bun run generate:check && bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && bun test examples/verso && bun examples/verso/smoke.ts
scripts.test:game: bun run generate:check && bun test examples/cordon-off && bun examples/cordon-off/smoke.ts && bun examples/cordon-off/smoke.ts --tls
scripts.generate:types: bun sdk/typescript/cli/generate.ts --schema examples/cordon-off/schema.json --out examples/cordon-off/schema-types.ts && bun sdk/typescript/cli/generate.ts --schema examples/quorum/schema.json --out examples/quorum/schema-types.ts
scripts.generate:check: bun sdk/typescript/cli/generate.ts --schema examples/cordon-off/schema.json --out examples/cordon-off/schema-types.ts --check && bun sdk/typescript/cli/generate.ts --schema examples/quorum/schema.json --out examples/quorum/schema-types.ts --check
scripts.test:e2e: bun test tests/e2e/src/e2e.test.ts && bun test tests/e2e/src/react-e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:tsan: bash scripts/tsan-prep.sh && zig build test -Dsanitize=thread --summary all --error-style minimal; tsan_exit=$?; bash scripts/tsan-prep.sh --restore; exit $tsan_exit
scripts.lint: zsort check . --ban-prefix ./ --ban-prefix src/ --remove-unused && zig fmt --check src && zlint --deny-warnings && zwanzig --format text --skip unused-decl src && zig build check --summary all
scripts.lint:fix: zsort fix . --ban-prefix ./ --ban-prefix src/ --remove-unused && zig fmt src
scripts.typecheck: bun run generate:check && bun run typecheck:sdk && bun run typecheck:e2e && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run typecheck:benchmark
